$comment: Gzip ceilings (bytes) for the BUILT site, checked by scripts/check-site-perf-budget.ts in deploy-site.yml after a real `jx build`. A page ceiling covers the HTML plus every same-origin asset that HTML eagerly references, derived from the built markup rather than listed here. Raise a ceiling deliberately, with justification, when a real feature grows it.
$baseline: Measured on the build that minified browser bundles, inlined component CSS, emitted modulepreload hints, stopped emitting the search corpus twice, and made the search client a lazy import. Before that change the same home page cost 50,651 gz bytes across 18 requests and every visitor also downloaded search-index.json (409,178 gz) whether or not they searched — 491 KiB total, which is what prompted these budgets.
$ratchet-search-index: Change review's documentation (studio/publish/source-control.md gains a 'Read a change' section, plus a Diff section in interface/modes.md and one in logic/code.md) moved the index 392824 -> 394495 gz bytes, +1671. The 375000 ceiling was already being met on TOLERANCE rather than under the ceiling: main sat at 104.8%, with 926 bytes of the 5% allowance left, so this was the growth that happened to cross rather than the growth that was unusual. Raised to just above the measured figure so the index is under its CEILING again and the tolerance is headroom for noise rather than the thing holding it up. The index is a pure function of the docs corpus, and this repository requires a behaviour change to ship its documentation in the same change set, so it grows whenever the docs do; the lever if it needs shrinking is the corpus the search client actually needs, not the prose.
$ratchet-search-index-kit-docs: The kit and the embedding contract are documented: docs/extending/ui-kit.md (one page for 38 elements, 843 lines), docs/extending/embedding/runtime-host.md, the accessibility, overlays, styling and props-and-scope concept pages, a standards page with a row per spec, and the spec changelog entries of ~40 spec releases, moved the index 394495 -> 443356 gz bytes, +48861 (+12.4%) and 112.2% of the 395000 ceiling. Raised to just above the measured figure, on this file's own rule: the index is a pure function of the docs corpus and this repository ships documentation in the same change set as behaviour, so a whole design system arrives with its manual. Measured where the bytes are: the generated spec changelog is 6.6% of the index's entries and the kit page 4.7%, so the lever the previous note named — the corpus the search client actually needs — has a first candidate the day this needs to shrink: a per-page opt-out in @jxsuite/search for generated reference pages, which is an extension feature and not this change's.
